integrity: The three-edge upper chain is credited to the source; the new contribution is the proof of the sharp lower bound and the negative compact-quasinilpotent example. No claim of independent review or mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Only complex unilateral weighted shifts on ell_p, 1<=p<infty, with bounded nonzero weights; not all compact quasinilpotents, not bilateral or zero-weight shifts. The strongest relevant older 2013 article was accessible as abstract only, leaving priority risk. Finite tests do not establish the infinite-dimensional result.
title: Rank-one commuting distance three for injective unilateral weighted shifts
